The Problem

Your school is present but invisible.

📸
Events happen. Content doesn't.
Annual Day, Sports Day, Science Fair — 23+ events a year, each full of story. But no one outside the hall ever sees them, because there's no system capturing and publishing in real time.
😓
Teachers can't do everything.
Asking a teacher to manage Instagram on top of lesson plans, PTMs, and exams stretches their bandwidth impossibly thin. It always slips. And when it does, parents notice the silence — even if they don't say anything.
📉
Engagement tells the real story.
Generic posts once a month get 40–80 likes. Schools with a content strategy are getting 1,000+ engagements per post. That gap is an admissions gap — and it compounds every month.
🏫
Nearby schools are already doing it.
Schools in your locality are building communities online that translate directly into inquiry calls. The first school in your area to do this properly wins the parent's attention — and trust — before anyone else does.
